'''Energy bola''' was a weapon utilized by the [[Chev]] security forces on [[Metellos 3]] that would snag and entangle the victim in energized wires.

They were also used as a capturing weapon by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including the famous [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]], [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
